purpose: Test a constitutively derived near-saturation coordinate that targets the low-n MvG conductivity curvature which defeated both linear-h and uniform-S wet axes.

derivation.near_saturation_behavior: (1-S^(1/m))^m is proportional to |h|^(n*m)=|h|^(n-1), so the leading conductivity deficit toward KSATFIT is governed by |h|^(n-1)
derivation.coordinate: t=1-(-h)^(n-1) for -1<=h<0, normalized so t=0 at h=-1 and t=1 at h=0

physical_scope.hydraulic_family: Staringreeks 2018 unimodal base MvG, KSATFIT, H_ENPR=0, KSATEXM disabled

fixed_axes.saturated_wet: linear pressure head h on [0,+1] cm, N=17
fixed_axes.persistent_state: unified pressure head from E1; transformed coordinate is lookup/worker-only

candidate_unsaturated_wet_axis.selection_rule: smallest candidate passing every frozen metric for every material

stored_face_quantity.reason_for_retaining_logM: R0 did not classify the log-mobility transform as dominant

probe_plan.distribution: uniform physical wet h over [-1,+1] and uniform dry u over [0,4]

required_diagnostics: last nonzero negative head represented by each candidate per material
conceptual full WET_DRY table memory and zero per-column table state
hard_guards: E2A and R1A failures remain authoritative negative evidence.
No threshold relaxation, physics change, Class-B reopening or dry-axis retuning.
A passing R2A permits only a separately frozen full-region R2B characterization.
